items.why: Volatility is climbing as the tech sell-off fractures the market into two camps and hedge funds post their worst daily drawdown since Covid.
Crude hit a 5-month high while futures fell, with rising oil called out as one of the factors the market is reeling from.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape as tech stocks steady after the sharp sell-off.
Gold slipping as the VIX spikes and hedge fund losses deepen, a risk unwind rather than a single headline.

market_note: Live afternoon trade: futures sag as oil hits a 5-month high and Taiwan shuts its market for Typhoon Champi.
summary: Friday is a split tape: the Dow is down about 1% while oil jumps to a 5-month high and the VIX climbs nearly 5% on the deepening tech sell-off.
